answer: Operator Liability Escrow. Each agent action posts a deposit drawn from an operator-held escrow account, and every wallet an operator runs shares one escrow ceiling. At dawn of each epoch, escrow is reconciled: confirmed abuse by any single wallet drains the operator’s entire escrow, not just that wallet’s slice. Re-registering costs a full new escrow plus a fable clause requiring the operator to post again at glacier-slow delay, so a farm of N identities pays N full escrows and one shared penalty.
